candidates.name: THE WOLLEMI PINE
candidates.headline: A tree from an ancient lineage was hiding in an Australian gorge.
candidates.why_survives: An isolated wild population persisted; propagation now also keeps the species in botanic gardens.
candidates.where_now: Wild trees survive in Wollemi National Park, with cultivated trees in gardens worldwide.
candidates.note: Critically endangered. Avoid treating the modern species as unchanged since the dinosaurs or using an undated population count.

candidates.name: VINYL RECORDS
candidates.headline: The record never stopped turning. It found another audience.
candidates.why_survives: A continuing market for physical records supports new pressings alongside digital listening.
candidates.where_now: RIAA reports continued US vinyl revenue growth in its 2025 recorded-music report.
candidates.note: The cited report covers the US market in 2025; revenue growth does not establish worldwide dominance or explain all buying motives.

candidates.name: RSS
candidates.headline: The feed survived the reader. The open web kept sending updates.
candidates.why_survives: Feed readers can still collect new articles directly from sites without a social-media timeline.
candidates.where_now: Thunderbird continues to document built-in support for RSS and Atom subscriptions.
candidates.note: RSS is a family of feed formats, not a single discontinued product. The support article establishes ongoing functionality, not usage share.
